description: Register an existing scratch directory as a work folder in the solet's own database, so that what it is for, which work item it belongs to, who made it and what must be kept before it is removed are on record and the sweep can finish it safely. Call it right after creating a temporary, capture, cache or evidence directory. path must be an absolute path to an existing real directory (a symlink resolves to its target, which is what is recorded; the filesystem root is refused). bound is 'kind:ref', split at the first colon, naming the work item the folder belongs to, for example release_run:run-12. harvest says what must be kept before removal: regenerable (the default, nothing to keep), evidence_copy or custody_packet (a harvest receipt is needed before the sweep may remove it). The call is idempotent for a live path: a path whose record is not deleted returns that same row unchanged and writes nothing, so a creator that runs twice registers once; a deleted record is terminal, so the path can be opened again as a new row. A new row starts in state 'open' at version 1 with one 'opened' history event. owner and the agent identity are recorded for the history only; the call never refuses by who is asking. If the live record's directory identity (dev and ino) no longer matches the directory now at the path, the row comes back with one identity_changed advisory, is not rewritten, and the sweep will keep the directory.
embedding_description: Register a scratch, capture or cache directory as a work folder so the solet knows what created it, which work item it belongs to and what must be kept before it is removed. Safe to repeat for the same path. Use right after a creator makes a temporary folder.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Work-folder row with keys folder_id (wkf-<hex>), path (canonical real path), state (open|due|harvested|retired|deleted), version (int, 1 for a new row), dev and ino (identity of the directory as decimal text), purpose, bound_kind, bound_ref, harvest_kind (regenerable|evidence_copy|custody_packet), owner, harvest_receipt (JSON text, empty until harvested) and advisories (list: one identity_changed entry when the directory at the path is not the one recorded, otherwise empty).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: State the folder_id, the path and the state. The call does not say whether the row is new: a version above 1 or a state other than open means the path was already registered and nothing changed, which is success, not an error. If advisories is not empty, name each code and message.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Keep folder_id and version: pass the version as expected_version to transition_work_folder. Do not call open_work_folder again to check; read_work_folders mode show answers the current state.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Registering one directory as a work folder in the solet's own database through the state service
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: invalid_path: path is not absolute, is not an existing real directory, or is the filesystem root. invalid_argument: bound is not 'kind:ref'. invalid_field: harvest is not regenerable, evidence_copy or custody_packet. state_service_unavailable: the state service is not bound, so nothing was written. The code is in data.error_code and prefixes the error text.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For invalid_path, create the directory first and pass its absolute path. For invalid_argument or invalid_field, correct the named argument and call again. For state_service_unavailable, do not retry in a loop: confirm the solet finished starting (list_plugins shows the state plugin ready) and retry once it has. A folder that was never registered is never swept, so registering it later is harmless.
